about: Every visible shape on the F/A-18C, region by region, with the reference photos that show it and whether the model matches (../verify/README.md, step 7). status: matches, wrong (with what is wrong), or unchecked. Numbers are the photo match's (photos.json) or the facts check's (check.py) as of the date; a shape inside the outline is only ever verified here.
